<strong>Orari indicativi di risposta:</s: Typical response times: 2–5 working days for standard requests; for urgent issues involving a compromised account, say so in the subject line.
Il messaggio arriva al team su <strong>s: Your message reaches the team at support@projectevil.it and we reply to the address you give. If you are signed in, you also receive a confirmation email.
Su quale pagina o strumento? Cosa stavi: Which page or tool? What were you doing and what happened?
Cosa scrivere nella richiesta: What to include in your request
Per aiutarti in modo rapido, includi:: To help us help you quickly, include:
Indirizzo email usato per l'account EVIL: The email address you use for your EVIL account (if relevant).
Pagina o strumento (es. Lab virtuale, Ch: The page or tool (e.g. Virtual lab, URL check, Quiz centre).
Descrizione del problema o del concetto: A description of the problem or of the concept you want clarified.
Browser e dispositivo (es. Chrome su Win: Browser and device (e.g. Chrome on Windows, Safari on iPhone), if the problem concerns the layout or a button.
Il testo esatto dell'eventuale messaggio: The exact text of any error message. To send a screenshot, write directly to support@projectevil.it.
Spiegazioni su quiz, lab, simulatori e p: Explanations of quizzes, labs, simulators and learning paths.
Problemi di registrazione, login, verifi: Problems with sign-up, sign-in, email verification or password recovery.
Funzionamento degli strumenti di analisi: How the analysis tools work in an authorised, defensive context.
Segnalazioni di bug o contenuti errati n: Reports of bugs or incorrect content on the platform.
<strong>Non forniamo supporto</strong> p: We do not provide support for offensive activities, bypassing security on third-party systems or using the tools without authorisation. See also the site policies.
L'email di verifica non arriva: The verification email does not arrive
Controlla spam e promozioni e aspetta qu: Check spam and promotions and wait a few minutes. If it does not show up, go back to the sign-in page and request a new one: the previous link stops working.
Non riesco ad accedere o ho dimenticato: I cannot sign in or forgot my password
Dalla pagina di accesso usa «Hai dimenti: On the sign-in page use “Forgot your password?”: you will receive a link to choose a new one. If the problem continues, write to us with your account email.
La pagina è senza grafica o un pulsante: The page has no styling or a button does not respond
Ricarica la pagina senza cache (Ctrl + M: Reload the page without cache (Ctrl + Shift + R) and disable extensions that block scripts for this site. If it persists, tell us your browser and device.
Lab virtuale: «Avvia VM» non risponde: Virtual lab: “Start VM” does not respond
Il lab ha un limite di sessioni contempo: The lab has a limit on simultaneous sessions: wait for a previous one to end and try again. The red message under the card explains the exact reason.
I miei progressi non sono uguali su due: My progress differs between two devices
I progressi sono legati all'account: acc: Progress is tied to your account: sign in with the same account on both devices. Without signing in it stays on that browser only.
Uno strumento di Verifica mi porta alla: A Verify tool takes me to sign-up
Gli strumenti che interrogano siti reali: Tools that query real sites require a free account, to limit abuse. After signing in you return to the tool page.
